sv.title: Ted Åström: ”Det var nära att jag strök med”
sv.summary: Ted Åström har tvingats amputera sitt högerben. Nu hyllar han sjukvården och sin sambo Charlotte. – Det var nära att jag strök med, säger han.

en.title: Ted Åström: "It was close that I didn't make it"
en.summary: Ted Åström has had to have his right leg amputated. Now he praises the health care and his partner Charlotte. – It was close that I didn't make it, he says.
